statement: For every byte slice s satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r (it does not fail) and r = val(s), where val(s) is defined as follows. Let n = len(s). Let k be the smallest index in [0, n] such that k = n or s[k] != 32 (space); thus s[0..k) are all spaces. Let p = k. If p < n and (s[p] == 43 ('+') or s[p] == 45 ('-')), let sign = -1 if s[p] == 45 else +1, and let q = p + 1; otherwise let sign = +1 and q = p. Let m be the smallest index in [q, n] such that m = n or s[m] is not a digit (i.e., not (48 <= s[m] <= 57)). If m = q, set val(s) = 0. Otherwise let N = sum_{j=q}^{m-1} (s[j] - 48) * 10^(m-1-j) (a mathematical non-negative integer). Then if sign = +1, val(s) = min(N, 2147483647); if sign = -1, val(s) = max(-N, -2147483648).
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 200 and every byte of s is one of: an English letter (a-z, A-Z), a digit '0'-'9', a space ' ', a plus '+', a minus '-', or a period '.'.

statement: For any two byte slices s and t satisfying the preconditions, let the parsing data for s be (k_s, sign_s, q_s, m_s, N_s) and for t be (k_t, sign_t, q_t, m_t, N_t), defined as follows: for a slice x, let n_x = len(x); let k_x be the smallest index in [0, n_x] with k_x = n_x or x[k_x] != 32; if k_x < n_x and (x[k_x] == 43 or x[k_x] == 45), let sign_x = -1 if x[k_x] == 45 else +1 and q_x = k_x+1, else sign_x = +1 and q_x = k_x; let m_x be the smallest index in [q_x, n_x] with m_x = n_x or x[m_x] not in [48, 57]; if m_x > q_x, let N_x = sum_{j=q_x}^{m_x-1} (x[j]-48)*10^(m_x-1-j); if m_x = q_x, let N_x = 0. If N_s = N_t and either N_s = 0 or sign_s = sign_t, then my_atoi(s) = my_atoi(t).
preconditions: Both s and t are byte slices with 0 <= len(s) <= 200, 0 <= len(t) <= 200, and every byte of s and t is one of: an English letter (a-z, A-Z), a digit '0'-'9', a space ' ', a plus '+', a minus '-', or a period '.'.
